title: Chickpea tomato polenta
summary: Chickpea tomato polenta is a italian dinner built around polenta and canned chickpeas in water, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Chickpea tomato polenta. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add polenta and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and canned chickpeas in water.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until passata is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Chickpea tomato polenta before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Chickpea tomato polenta.  Serve with the polenta, simmered in salted water until tender.
